        lock_path: Path | str = DEFAULT_LOCK_PATH,
    ) -> None:
        self.profiles = profiles or load_profiles()
        self.client_factory = client_factory
        self.lock_path = Path(lock_path)

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _lock(self):
        self.lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.lock_path.open("a+", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Hermclaw role router")
    parser.add_argument("--stage", default="discovery")
    parser.add_argument("--target-path", action="append", default=[])
    parser.add_argument("--failures", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--complexity", default="normal")
    parser.add_argument("--explicit-role", choices=["fast", "main", "heavy"])
    args = parser.parse_args()

    decision = route_task(
        stage=args.stage,
        target_paths=args.target_path,
        failures=args.failures,
        complexity=args.complexity,
        explicit_role=args.explicit_role,
    )
    print(json.dumps(dataclasses.asdict(decision), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
